declare @q nvarchar(max), @slstt_rec nvarchar(max) select @slstt_rec = text from @lstt_rec
select top 0 @slstt_rec as data, b.line_nbr, b.stt_rec, cast(null as varchar(max)) as ddyn, ma_td1 as d_ma_td1, ma_hd as d_ma_hd, ma_sp as d_ma_sp, ma_vv as d_ma_vv , cast('' as nvarchar(max)) as d_tk_no, cast('' as nvarchar(max)) as d_tk_co , cast('' as nvarchar(max)) as d_ten_vv, ma_td3 as d_ma_td3, cast('' as nvarchar(max)) as d_ten_td3 into #m from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0
insert into #m(data) select data from [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$Split](@slstt_rec, char(252)) a where id > 1
update #m set line_nbr = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, char(253)), stt_rec = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 2, char(253))
if '&ddTable;' in ('42', '83', '26') update #m set ddyn = 'd&ddTable;$000000' else begin set @q = 'update #m set ddyn = ''d&ddTable;$'' + convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from #m a join c&ddTable;$000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' exec (@q) end
select top 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv, ma_td3 into #d from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0 select top 0 stt_rec, tk as tk_no, tk as tk_co into #d2 from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0
set @q = '' select @q = @q + 'insert into #d select stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv, ma_td3 from ' + ddyn + ' a where exists(select * from #m where stt_rec = a.stt_rec) and line_nbr = 1;' from #m where ddyn <> '' group by ddyn exec (@q)
set @q = '' select @q = @q + 'insert into #d2 select stt_rec , case when ps_no + ps_no_nt <> 0 then tk else '''' end , case when ps_co + ps_co_nt <> 0 then tk else '''' end from ' + ddyn + ' a where exists(select * from #m where stt_rec = a.stt_rec);' from #m where ddyn <> '' group by ddyn exec (@q)
SELECT stt_rec, STUFF( ( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + rtrim(tk_no) FROM #d2 t2 WHERE t2.stt_rec = t1.stt_rec and tk_no <> '' FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') , 1, 2, '') AS list_tk_no into #d2_group1 FROM #d2 t1 GROUP BY stt_rec; SELECT stt_rec, STUFF( ( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + rtrim(tk_co) FROM #d2 t2 WHERE t2.stt_rec = t1.stt_rec and tk_co <> '' FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') , 1, 2, '') AS list_tk_co into #d2_group2 FROM #d2 t1 GROUP BY stt_rec;
update #m set d_ma_td1 = b.ma_td1, d_ma_hd = b.ma_hd, d_ma_sp = b.ma_sp, d_ma_vv = b.ma_vv, d_ma_td3 = b.ma_td3 from #m a join #d b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec update #m set d_ten_vv = case when @@language = 'V' then b.ten_vv else b.ten_vv2 end from #m a join dmvv b on a.d_ma_vv = b.ma_vv update #m set d_ten_td3 = case when @@language = 'V' then b.ten_dtqt else b.ten_dtqt end from #m a join dmdtqt3 b on a.d_ma_td3 = b.ma_dtqt update #m set d_tk_no = b.list_tk_no from #m a join #d2_group1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec update #m set d_tk_co = b.list_tk_co from #m a join #d2_group2 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
select '' as array$, rtrim(a.d_ma_td1), rtrim(a.d_ma_hd), rtrim(d_ma_sp), rtrim(d_ma_vv), rtrim(d_tk_no), rtrim(d_tk_co) , isnull(d_ten_vv, '') d_ten_vv, rtrim(d_ma_td3) d_ma_td3, isnull(d_ten_td3, '') d_ten_td3 from #m a order by line_nbr return

query.text: declare @$pageCount int; select @$pageCount = case when @@pageCount < 0 then 0 else @@pageCount end; exec zFastBusiness$App$Voucher$Loading @@id, @@master, @@prime, @@partition, @@expression, @@extension, @$pageCount, 'stt_rec', @@textList, @@textExternal, ' a left join dmkh kh on a.ma_kh = kh.ma_kh', @@textOrderBy, @@admin, @@userID, @@viewAccessMode, 0, @@queryString , default , default, default, default, default, default, default, default, 'stt_rec, line_nbr,ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv, ma_td3', 'd11$', ' left join d11$ d1 on a.stt_rec = d1.stt_rec and d1.line_nbr = 1 left join dmhd hd on d1.ma_hd = hd.ma_hd left join dmdtqt3 qt3 on d1.ma_td3 = qt3.ma_dtqt left join zvdmvv vv on d1.ma_vv = vv.ma_vv'

declare @$detailF nvarchar(4000) = '' if exists(select * from #filter$dd) begin if @$detailPartition is null set @$detailPartition = '' if @$detailAlias is null set @$detailAlias = '' if @$detailFilter is null set @$detailFilter = ''
if exists(select ma_ct from dmct9 where ma_ct = @@id and d$ = 'd11$000000') set @$detailPartition = @$detailPartition + case when @$detailPartition = '' then '' else char(255) end + 'd11$000000' else set @$detailPartition = @$detailPartition + case when @$detailPartition = '' then '' else char(255) end + 'd11$%Partition' set @$detailAlias = @$detailAlias+ case when @$detailAlias = '' then '' else char(255) end + 'zdd'
if exists (select 1 from #filter$dd where field = 'd_ten_vv') begin select @$detailF = @$detailF + case when @$detailF = '' then '' else ' and ' end + ' exists (select 1 from dmvv vv where zdd.ma_vv = vv.ma_vv and ' + replace(conditional, char(255) + field, 'vv.ten_vv') + ')' from #filter$dd where field = 'd_ten_vv' delete #filter$dd where field = 'd_ten_vv' end
if exists (select 1 from #filter$dd where field = 'd_ten_td3') begin select @$detailF = @$detailF + case when @$detailF = '' then '' else ' and ' end + ' exists (select 1 from dmdtqt3 td3 where zdd.ma_td3 = td3.ma_dtqt and ' + replace(conditional, char(255) + field, 'td3.ten_dtqt') + ')' from #filter$dd where field = 'd_ten_td3' delete #filter$dd where field = 'd_ten_td3' end
select @$detailFilter = @$detailFilter + case when @$detailFilter = '' then '' else ' and ' end + replace(replace(replace(replace(conditional, char(255) + field, 'zdd' + '.' + field), 'zdd.d_', 'zdd.'), 'tk_no', 'tk'), 'tk_co', 'tk') --select @$detailFilter = @$detailFilter + case when @$detailFilter = '' then '' else ' and ' end + replace(replace(conditional, char(255) + field, 'zdd' + '.' + field), 'zdd.d_', 'zdd.') from #filter$dd order by id
select @$detailFilter = @$detailFilter + case when @$detailFilter = '' then '' else ' and ' end + @$detailF
--set @$detailFilter = '(' + @$detailFilter + ') and zdd.line_nbr = 1' end
select top 0 * into #dtmp from d11$000000 set @q = 'insert into #dtmp select * from d11$%Partition where %[line_nbr = 1]%' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, 1, 1
exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Finding @@id, @@master, @@prime, @@inquiry, @@partition, @@expression, @@increase, @@extension, @@refresh, @@pageIndex, @@pageCount, @@lastPage, @@lastCount, @@firstItem, @@lastItem, @@keyMaster, @@keyDetail, 'stt_rec', @@textList, @@textExternal, ' a left join #dtmp d1 on a.stt_rec = d1.stt_rec left join dmhd hd on d1.ma_hd = hd.ma_hd left join dmdtqt3 qt3 on d1.ma_td3 = qt3.ma_dtqt left join zvdmvv vv on d1.ma_vv = vv.ma_vv left join dmkh kh on a.ma_kh = kh.ma_kh', @@textOrderBy, @@admin, @@userID, @@viewAccessMode, @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, @so_ct1, @so_ct2, @status, @user_id0, @ma_dvcs
